description: New-member welcomes currently publish a plain display name in a top-level post, so the member is not notified. Use the candidate handle and DID to render an @handle mention with a valid protocol mention facet. Prefer a reply to an eligible introduction post when a safe URI/CID target is available. Otherwise publish the mention-aware top-level welcome. Do not publish a targeted welcome when the handle or DID cannot be resolved safely. Preserve idempotent effect keys and add record-shape, byte-index, dry-run, manual-publication, and live-protocol contract tests.
title: Tag new members in top-level welcome posts
